name: turf-vscode
description: Official VSCode extension for the Turf programming language

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Turf's language server compiles and analyzes source with a native binary; this is not safe to run automatically against untrusted workspaces.

turf.server.path.description: Path to the turf-lsp executable. If empty, the extension looks for a build next to the open workspace, then falls back to 'turf-lsp' on PATH.

turf.home.description: Value for the TURF_HOME environment variable passed to the server, used to resolve stdlib/installed-package imports. Leave empty to use the server's own default.

turf.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the Turf language server.

turf.diagnostics.enable.description: Enable diagnostics (errors/warnings) published by the language server.

turf.format.onSave.description: Run the Turf formatter automatically when saving a .tr file.

turf.completion.snippets.description: Include snippet-style (tab-stop) completions, e.g. call argument placeholders.
